meta.name: Charitraheen
meta.description: Hoichoi Originals presents “Charitraheen”, based on the novel by Sarat Chandra Chattopadhyay, with the twists and turns being much in sync with today’s world.

videos.title: Sei Sob Seyalera
videos.overview: Kiran is a beautiful young woman, who is loyal to her husband Haran. However, a dark secret lies in their married life that’s unknown to the world outside.

videos.title: Perfume
videos.overview: Kiran is unknowingly becoming the object of fantasy for men. Does she understand who is playing with her image and respect?

videos.title: Facebook Friend
videos.overview: While searching for Sabitri, a masseuse, Satish comes across Kiran and recognizes her. But how does he know her?

videos.title: Password
videos.overview: Kiran is shocked to find out about her Facebook account and her intimate pictures. Who created the account and why?

videos.title: Laj Nai Laj Nai
videos.overview: Kiran finds out Haran's dark secret and decides to play the game he started. How will her punishment for his affect their marriage?

videos.title: Perfume 2
videos.overview: Satish is desperate for love and intimacy. Will his search show him the true colors of some people in his life?

videos.title: Goodbye Shohor
videos.overview: The troubles and tension between Kiran and Haran increases. Will Kiran take her revenge and hurt Haran?

videos.title: Pain Is Immoral
videos.overview: The game of lust doesn't seem to end for Kiran as she loses herself in a maze of betrayal. Will she be able to find her way out?

videos.title: Noroker Khobor
videos.overview: Kiran is trapped in a world of pain and darkness. Meanwhile, someone is forcing his way into her life.

videos.title: Noroker Khobor 2
videos.overview: Kiran and Haran are finally taking a step towards togetherness. But will their love be successful?

videos.title: The Slut
videos.overview: The true colors of all the people in the story get revealed. Will they finally get what they deserve?

videos.title: A Tale Yet to Tell
videos.overview: Kiran's life changes after her husband's death. Does Satish find true love? Experience the story of love, lust, and lies.

videos.title: A New Home
videos.overview: Kiran once again steps into a new home with Dr. Abhay, where there's a surprise waiting for her. Meanwhile, will Bhengchi agree to meet her mother?

videos.title: Flesh and Blood
videos.overview: What's stopping Bhengchi from meeting her ex-boyfriend? Is Kiran unintentionally turning the good man in Abhay into a man eater?

videos.title: The Mistake
videos.overview: What mistake in the past has caused the separation between Bhengchi and Shabitri? Will Kiran falls prey to the lust of a man, once again in her life?

videos.title: Miss You Too
videos.overview: As Satish returns to his senses, Kiran's stay in the house is questioned. As Ushnish and Bhengchi miss each other, will the two finally reunite?

videos.title: Flesh and Blood 2
videos.overview: Will Satish help Kiran escape from Abhay who continues to prey on her? What does Bhengchi do to take her revenge on Usnish?

videos.title: Maze of Love
videos.overview: Sabitri confronts Abhay after seeing his pictures with Bhengchi, and meets someone unexpectedly. Will Nirupama gets over her traumatic past?

videos.title: The Last Breath
videos.overview: Kiran gets trapped by Richard and has to leave the house. Meanwhile, is Bhengchi getting close to Abhay, or is she planning revenge?

videos.title: Epitaph
videos.overview: Bhengchi and Nirupama both reach the most important phases in their lives. But, will Kiran's story end in peace and love?

videos.title: Far From the Madding Crowd
videos.overview: Rabeya - a psychiatrist, is touring rural Bengal with Satish as a guide. A riot breaks out in the vicinity, and at once they are targeted.

videos.title: Memories of a Murder
videos.overview: The rioters approach, as Rabeya and Satish are stuck in the resort. Rabeya tells Satish about her dark past, and they connect.

videos.title: Lost and Found
videos.overview: Satish and Rabeya are assaulted by the rioters. Satish finds her way, but Rabeya is driven away.

videos.title: She Rises from Her Grave
videos.overview: Satish sees Kiranmayee. Is she an illusion? In the process of finding out, Satish meets Richard.

videos.title: Who Owns The Cunt
videos.overview: Abhay and Rabeya share a clandestine bond, but it's falling apart. Satish finds out something horrifying through the CCTV footage.

videos.title: The Shadow
videos.overview: As Rabeya tries to get closer to Satish, the shadow of Kiranmayee grows stronger. Is this a bigger ploy?

videos.title: How to Forget Her
videos.overview: Satish is brought to Rabeya for the treatment of his mental health. Rabeya tries to bring Kiran out of Satish.

videos.title: A Deep Conspiracy
videos.overview: Satish senses conspiracy to make Kiran an illusion. Satish finds Kiranmayee in his room, but Abhay and Nirupama insist she is an illusion.

videos.title: The Last Meeting
videos.overview: Satish follows Richard and ends up in his house. Everyone believes Satish is insane, but Rabeya promises him one last glimpse of Kiran.

videos.title: The Charitraheens
videos.overview: Rabeya takes Satish to the place from where Shoaib jumped to death. Satish gets a last clue from Kiran, can he find her?
